resolution: Added floor-level controls to the loader iso pane so the user can go up a storey and build on it. The IsoStage already modeled build levels (pose.level: camera target + pick plane rise with it, placeGroundAt lands pieces on the active floor's slab at level*METERS_PER_LEVEL) — the loader pane just had no way to change level. Added: a ▼/Floor N/▲ HUD control pinned top-left (above the pointer-capture layer so its buttons take clicks) + keys ]/PageUp (up) and [/PageDown (down); changeLevel calls stage.setLevel (clamps at ground), mirrors the level into state for the HUD, pushes the new camera so the view follows the floor up, and re-resolves the armed ghost in place. Placement + live preview were already level-aware, so building on an upper floor lands and previews live with no further wiring. TSX-only, hot-reloads. Committed 35d6a1961. NOTE: separately flagged a V8 heap OOM in the dev host on this massive map (892k instances) aggravated by hot reloads + my full-map live-skin scans; proposed a persisted-baseline fix, awaiting the user's go-ahead.
